_about: The nightly flash reading's RECORDED VALUES (the EP, 2026-11-21; re-recorded 2026-11-26, see `basis`). tools/flash/nightly-ci.mjs --baseline turns the nightly red when a clip reads WORSE than its recorded value on any of the four, when a clip has no recorded value, or when a reading is missing; it is green only when every clip equals or beats its recorded value. This file is read ONLY by the nightly: the outside-tester gate (G21), the release pass and the take-down line of 3 read the absolute line and do not use it. rushcity is recorded at 3, over our gate of 2.5 and on the line of 3: the nightly says nothing new about it until it gets worse. Update a value by hand, with the EP's word, when a clip reads better and stays better; never to follow a clip that reads worse.
basis: the worse of two dispatched nightlies on d9bc2f07 (runs 45873938790 and 45873942592; they read the same on every figure), the first with the re-cut windows after GB-010 (docs/tools/runs/d9bc2f07/flash-nightly-baseline.md). collapse-reduced is NOT re-recorded: it reads 4 / 4 / 3 (primary, area, two-second memory), worse than the value kept here and over the take-down line of 3, and a value is never changed to follow a clip that reads worse: the nightly stays red on it until it is fixed or explained.
